The '''Nentan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nentan]].
